groups.description: Official comparison sources, not verified competitive win/loss evidence.

links.title: Onguard
links.relevance: Direct alternative for multinational credit and collections teams: receivables visibility, configurable follow-up, disputes and related invoicing. Competitive relevance is inferred from workflow overlap, not a verified POM shortlist.

links.title: CreditDevice
links.relevance: Regional direct alternative combining credit information, receivables management and credit-insurance policy management. Its adjacent risk functions extend beyond the approved-receivable resolution boundary.

links.title: FIQAS / Abillity
links.relevance: Direct alternative combining recurring billing, payment processing, reconciliation and debtor follow-up. Broader rating and subscription functions precede this domain's approved-receivable starting point.

links.title: Sidetrade
links.relevance: Enterprise order-to-cash alternative covering invoicing, collections, disputes, cash application and buyer self-service with AI capabilities. Equivalence to POM's consumer or housing workflows is not assumed.

links.title: Billtrust
links.relevance: Broad B2B receivables alternative with invoicing, payments, credit, collections and cash application. Its supplier orientation must be considered against institutional and consumer-facing collection uses.

links.title: HighRadius
links.relevance: Enterprise finance-automation alternative with collections, cash application, deductions and electronic invoicing. Broader accounts-payable and treasury products are outside this comparison.

links.title: PAIR Finance
links.relevance: Digital collection-service substitute for outsourcing receivable resolution. Its service and escalation responsibilities differ from creditor-operated invoicing and payment software.

links.title: Mollie
links.relevance: Adjacent payment option: links and branded checkout can satisfy a simple get-paid job. Payment access alone does not establish equivalent arrears policy, support arrangements or housing case management.

links.title: Exact
links.relevance: ERP/accounting substitute when native invoicing, reminders and payment links are sufficient. Tests whether specialist collection software earns its added integration and subscription cost.
